title: 7 alarmes em 29 minutos
concept: Top-down work desk: the phone's lock screen 'rewinds' from 16:37 to 16:07, then a time-lapse clock replays the customer's 7 real alarms at their real minutes (with the 13-minute silence), the counter climbs 0→7, and the real print confirms 5 shiny alarms, 1 rare drop and 1 capture.
claims: detecção de shinys, megas e bosses
alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp

notes: Hook changed from '7 ALARMES EM 30 MINUTOS' to the precise '7 ALARMES EM 29 MINUTOS' (16:08–16:37 in the print; ASSETS.md says 29 min). Instead of dropping print rows during the build, a time-lapse clock (0.2 s per real minute) replays the 7 real alarm minutes on a generic mock lock screen (blurred), including the real 13-minute gap; the real print is revealed after the stop and its rows are re-counted 1→7. Concept line 'E ele nem tava olhando' (an inference) replaced by the true product line 'Você não precisa ficar olhando. O celular avisa.'; the reaction 'vou la conferir' + 👀 is shown in a crop of the same print with its time (16:41, 4 min after the last alarm). Music: trap 145 with a beat bed, build and stop instead of tension.
